mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.type, c.source_id, c.msg_type, c.parent_id, parent.user_nickname AS parent_nickname, c.reply_user_id, c.reply_user_nickname, c.user_id, c.user_nickname, c.user_avatar, c.content, c.like_num, c.status, c.is_top, c.ip_address, c.browser, c.os, c.device_type, c.location, c.create_time, c.update_time, CASE WHEN c.type = 0 THEN a.title WHEN c.type = 1 THEN LEFT(d.content, 50) WHEN c.type = 2 THEN '留言板' ELSE NULL END AS source_title, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment r WHERE r.parent_id = c.id AND r.delete_flag = 0 ) AS reply_count FROM comment c LEFT JOIN article a ON c.type = 0 AND c.source_id = a.id LEFT JOIN daily d ON c.type = 1 AND c.source_id = d.id LEFT JOIN comment parent ON c.parent_id = parent.id AND parent.delete_flag = 0
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.is_top DESC, c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id FROM comment c
ORDER BY c.is_top DESC, c.create_time DESC

WITH RECURSIVE reply_tree AS ( SELECT c.id FROM comment c WHERE c.delete_flag = 0 AND c.parent_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT c.id FROM comment c INNER JOIN reply_tree rt ON c.parent_id = rt.id WHERE c.delete_flag = 0 )
WHERE c.id IN (SELECT id FROM reply_tree) AND c.status = #{status} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
